champion_rule: Select the highest pooled correctness policy on the complete closed development panel after all Q3.0 method choices are frozen; ties use evaluability, lower generated-token mean, then lexicographic policy ID.
cost: one policy generation per item plus at most one explicitly counted prompt-prefill-equivalent feature forward
future_primary_estimand: mean family-level correctness(router-selected policy - frozen development-selected champion)
matched_random_subspace_specificity: unresolved and outside the Q3 claim
multiplicity: one primary router-versus-champion contrast; Holm within declared secondary family
primary_inference: one-sided paired family-level randomization test plus a simulation-calibrated paired interval
